items.claim: parseBody() after c.req.formData() now re-serializes the cached FormData and fails or returns garbage
items.consequence: Before this change parseBody() went through HonoRequest.formData(), which returns bodyCache.formData when it exists. Now it always calls HonoRequest.arrayBuffer(). With only bodyCache.formData populated, #cachedBody('arrayBuffer') rebuilds the bytes with new Response(formData).arrayBuffer(), a fresh multipart body with a new random boundary. bufferToFormData then parses those bytes under the original request's Content-Type. Multipart throws 'Failed to parse body as FormData'. Urlencoded silently returns a single garbage key.
items.proposed_fix: In parseFormData, when request is a HonoRequest and request.bodyCache.formData is already set, await and use it directly (as the old request.formData() path did) before falling back to arrayBuffer() + bufferToFormData(). Add a regression test for formData() then parseBody().

bodyCache = {formData}; arrayBuffer() falls to the anyCachedKey branch: new Response(formData).arrayBuffer() -> undici multipart bytes with a new boundary
bufferToFormData(bytes, original Content-Type): multipart -> TypeError; urlencoded -> one key '------formdata-undici-...\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name' with the rest as value
Reproduced on review-head with a scratch probe (HonoRequest over a real Request): multipart -> TypeError, urlencoded -> garbage key. parseBody() then formData() and repeated parseBody() work.

native_payload.intent: Make Content-Type media-type matching case-insensitive in parseBody(), bufferToFormData() and validator() while keeping parameters such as multipart boundaries intact (fixes #5060). The change also reroutes parseFormData through arrayBuffer() and bufferToFormData() and caches the result in HonoRequest.bodyCache.formData.

pre_existing_findings.title: method-override middleware still matches Content-Type case-sensitively
pre_existing_findings.suggested_fix: Reuse the same lower-cased media-type extraction as parseBody in method-override lines 74 and 92.
pre_existing_findings.why_it_matters: A form-based _method override sent with 'Application/X-WWW-Form-Urlencoded' or 'Multipart/Form-Data' is still skipped, though parseBody and validator now accept the same header. This is the #5060 bug class in a sibling consumer.
evidence: startsWith('multipart/form-data') is false -> next() without override

residual_risks: Plain Request and HonoRequest callers of parseBody: bodyCache.arrayBuffer and bodyCache.formData are now both retained for the request lifetime, which roughly doubles retained memory for large uploads (adversarial read, not measured).

Calling c.req.text() or c.req.json() before parseBody() on a multipart upload now rebuilds the bytes from UTF-8-decoded text and can silently mangle binary file parts. The old path threw. Confidence 50, adversarial read reproduced it on a scratch case.

validator regexes are still stricter than parseBody for other legal header shapes, e.g. whitespace before ';' ('application/x-www-form-urlencoded ;charset=UTF-8') yields {} from validator('form') while parseBody parses it. This predates the PR, but it is the same silent-skip symptom as #5060.
Custom Request subclasses or test doubles that override formData() are now bypassed by parseBody(). The removed vi.spyOn(req,'formData') mock in body.test.ts no longer exercises that path.
testing_gaps: No test for c.req.formData() followed by c.req.parseBody() on the same HonoRequest, which is where finding 1 occurs. No test for repeated parseBody() or parseBody() followed by c.req.formData() either.
No test combining parseBody and validator('form') in one route with a mixed-case Content-Type.
No test for method-override with a mixed-case Content-Type.

coverage.notes: Focused path: own correctness read plus one in-process adversarial reviewer (same model family, not cross-model; the cross-model peer was unavailable by instruction). No other reviewers and no validator ran. Plan: none found (PR body only references #5060). Criteria files: none govern the change. Compound Packs not applied. Learnings, agent-native gaps and deployment notes not assessed. The probe for finding 1 was a scratch run on review-head; it was not run against main, so the old behaviour comes from reading HonoRequest.#cachedBody. Untracked files: none.
